title: NieR: Automata
japaneseTitle: ニーア オートマタ
shortDescription: Yoko Taro and PlatinumGames' philosophical action-RPG masterpiece exploring existentialism and humanity through combat androids 2B, 9S, and A2.
historicalSignificance: A landmark achievement in video game narrative structure requiring multiple perspective playthroughs to reach its transcendent Ending E, selling over 8 million copies and featuring one of gaming's greatest musical scores.

editorialContent.overview: Set in the year 11945 AD during the 14th Machine War between synthetic androids created by fleeing humans and biomechanical machine lifeforms deployed by alien invaders, NieR: Automata deconstructs what it means to possess consciousness and purpose.
editorialContent.gameplay: Masterfully shifts across genres—seamlessly transitioning from lightning-fast PlatinumGames hack-and-slash combat into top-down twin-stick bullet hell shooters, side-scrolling platformers, and text adventures.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Pioneered interactive musical layering where Keiichi Okabe's haunting vocal themes transition dynamically between 8-bit chiptune hacking modes and grand choral crescendos based on combat intensity.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Character 2B became an instant worldwide design icon, and Ending E's fourth-wall-breaking communal sacrifice stands as an unforgettable artistic triumph.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on PS4 physical disc, enhanced for PS4 Pro, and ported to all major platforms.

awards: Japan Game Awards Award for Excellence

technicalSpecs.soundChip: Dynamic adaptive acoustic audio by MONACA
